# Tooling and workflow {#sec-tooling}

This page lists the commands of the project, the automated checks, and the way the
team and the code agents work together. Everything is run from the repository
root.

## The Makefile {.unnumbered}

`Makefile` is the single entry for the commands of the project. It includes two
smaller files: `resources/make/Makefile.git` for the branch workflow and
`resources/make/Makefile.quarto` for this book.

### Setting up and checking {.unnumbered}

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `make venv` | Creates `.venv`. |
| `make install` | Installs the package in editable mode with the development extras (`pytest`, `jsonschema`, `flake8`, `pydocstyle`). |
| `make install-requirements` | Installs `requirements.txt`, the list that Qollab reads. |
| `make test` | Runs the whole suite with `pytest source/tests/ -v`. |
| `make lint` | Runs `flake8` and `pydocstyle` on the library, the examples, the adapters, the scripts and the tests. |
| `make demo M=<module>` | Runs `resources/scripts/demo_<module>.py`. |

### Producing and serving {.unnumbered}

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `make outputs` | Writes the example JSON files and `manifest.json` to `out/`. |
| `make qollab` | Builds `qollab/`, the JS project to upload to Qollab. |
| `make server` | Serves the viewer at `http://localhost:8000` with compiling and measuring in Python (`PORT=9000` changes the port). |
| `make open` | Like `server`, and also opens the browser. |
| `make resume` | Shows the branch, the last commits, the unpushed changes and the pending list of `memory.md`. |

### Diagrams {.unnumbered}

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `make install-plantuml` | Installs PlantUML and Graphviz with `apt`. |
| `make render-puml` | Renders `documentation/diagrams/*.puml` to `documentation/diagrams/svg/`. |

The SVG files are committed, so building the book does not need PlantUML.

### The book {.unnumbered}

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `make render` | Renders every format configured in `documentation/_quarto.yml`. |
| `make html` | Renders the HTML book only. |
| `make pdf-typst` | Renders the PDF with Typst. |
| `make preview` | Serves the book on port 4321 and re-renders a chapter when it is saved. |
| `make check` | Verifies the Quarto toolchain. |
| `make clean` | Removes `documentation/_book` and the caches. |

## The scripts {.unnumbered}

The scripts in `resources/scripts/` are tools, not part of the library. They may use
`print`.

| Script | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `demo_<module>.py` | One per stage (`transpiler`, `translator`, `simulator`, `vectorizer`, `metrics`, `compile`, `adder`). It prints a result that a person can read. |
| `generate_outputs.py` | Compiles the example circuits and writes `out/`. |
| `package_qollab.py` | Builds `qollab/`. |
| `server.py` | The local server of the viewer. |
| `_common.py` | Helpers shared by the demos. |

## Continuous integration {.unnumbered}

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` has two jobs, on every push to `main` and `development`
and on every pull request.

| Job | Steps |
| --- | --- |
| Lint | `flake8` and `pydocstyle`, with the same arguments as `make lint`. |
| Tests | `pip install -e ".[dev]"`, then `pytest`, on Python 3.12 and 3.13. |

A new run of the same branch cancels the previous one. The token has read-only
permissions. Because the workflow repeats the Makefile commands, a change that
passes `make test` and `make lint` locally passes in CI.

## Branches and commits {.unnumbered}

`Makefile.git` encodes the branch workflow, so that nobody has to remember the
commands.

| Branch | Purpose | Created by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `main` | Stable code. | `make git-init` |
| `development` | Integration of the next version. Work is pushed here. | `make git-init`, `make development` |
| `feature/<name>` | One module or feature. | `make feature NAME=<name>` |
| `release/<version>` | Stabilising a version. | `make release VERSION=<x.y.z>` |
| `hotfix/<version>` | An urgent fix of the published code. | `make hotfix VERSION=<x.y.z>` |

A feature is merged back with `make finish-feature NAME=<name>`, which uses
`--no-ff` so that the branch stays visible in the history. A release or a hotfix is
tagged `v<version>` and merged into both `main` and `development`.

The same file has short helpers for daily use: `status`, `log`, `diff`, `stage`,
`unstage`, `commit MESSAGE="…"`, `amend`, `push`, `pull` (fast-forward only) and
`fetch`.

Commit messages are in English. The first line is a short summary, and a body with
bullets is added when it helps.

## How a module is built {.unnumbered}

The specification defines the modules M0 to M10. For each one the same cycle is
followed.

1. Check in the status table of the specification that the previous module is
   validated.
2. Read the complete section of the module: objective, rules, tests and demo.
3. Implement that module only, with its tests in `source/tests/test_<module>.py`
   and its demo in `resources/scripts/demo_<module>.py`.
4. Run `make test` and the demo. Both must pass.
5. Mark the module *ready to validate* in the specification.
6. Stop and report what was done, how to validate it (with exact commands and the
   expected output), what is still unverified on Qollab and any deviation from the
   specification.
7. Continue with the next module when the team agrees.

If the work shows that the specification is wrong, the code and the specification
are corrected together and the report says so. A change to the JSON contract is not
made without asking.

## Working with code agents {.unnumbered}

Three files in the root tell an agent how to work, and they are written in Spanish
because the team is.

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `AGENTS.md` | The rules: architecture, Qollab restrictions, tests, commands, Git and the scope. |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Imports `AGENTS.md` and `memory.md`, so that both are loaded at the start of a session. |
| `memory.md` | The hand-over: current state, decisions, pending items and the history. It is updated after each change and a test keeps it under 150 lines. |

At the start of a session the agent pulls, reads `memory.md` and runs
`make resume`. At the end it runs `make test` and `make lint`, brings `memory.md`
up to date and, only if the team asks, commits and pushes.

## The tests of the project itself {.unnumbered}

Some tests do not check behaviour. They check that the project stays coherent.

| Test | Keeps in line |
| --- | --- |
| `test_requirements.py` | `requirements.txt` and the dependencies of `pyproject.toml`. |
| `test_memory.py` | `memory.md`, which must have its sections and stay short. |
| `test_package_qollab.py` | The Qollab package, its limits and its services. |
| `test_smoke.py` | The public API of `backend`. |

## Before closing a change {.unnumbered}

A short list that applies to any change.

- [ ] `make test` is green.
- [ ] `make lint` is green.
- [ ] If the viewer, `qollab_api.py` or the packager changed: `make qollab`.
- [ ] The affected chapter of this book is updated.
- [ ] `memory.md` has the new state and a line of history.
- [ ] If the JSON contract changed, the schema, the golden file and
      [JSON contract](../concepts/json-contract.qmd) agree, and the team knew.
